technical_and_design_decisions: Use Maven for build and dependency management to enforce library version control and isolation (addressing U1, U2, U4).
Follow existing Spring Cloud Data Flow (s-c-d) and Spring Cloud Stream (s-c-s) project conventions and patterns for ported modules (U3, U5).
Implement a modular architecture for new components like ModuleRegistry to ensure separation of concerns (U7).
Extend the Spring Cloud Data Flow Shell (s-c-d-s) command structure to add new CLI commands (U8).
Utilize Spring's standard testing patterns, including integration tests with testcontainers where required, for new features (all).
assumptions: The development team has existing access to and familiarity with the s-c-d and s-c-s codebases.
A standard Maven project structure exists, and we can create new sub-modules or projects within the existing reactor.
The 'uber-jar' refers to the final executable Spring Cloud Data Flow server jar.
The 'offline mode' for AetherModuleResolver will be a configuration flag that prevents network calls to remote Maven repositories.
The CLI commands (U8) will be implemented as extensions to the existing Spring Cloud Data Flow Shell.
Testing infrastructure (unit, integration) and a CI/CD pipeline are already in place.
Documentation updates (e.g., README, configuration guides) are standard tasks accompanying feature development.

activities.activity_name: Configure Maven Dependency and Packaging for Library Isolation
activities.activity_description: Analyze the current uber-jar Maven build configuration. Identify the dependency causing conflicts. Add a `<dependencyManagement>` section or use the Maven Enforcer plugin to ban specific transitive dependency versions. Modify the `spring-boot-maven-plugin` configuration to ensure the external library is not overridden.

activities.activity_name: Create New Maven Module for External Library
activities.activity_description: Create a new Maven module (e.g., `s-c-d-external-lib`) in the repository's top-level POM. Move the source code, resources, and unit tests from the current location to the new module. Update all dependent modules to reference the new artifact coordinates.

activities.activity_name: Port SFTP Module from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream
activities.activity_description: Obtain the SFTP module source from the Spring XD repository. Refactor the module to align with Spring Cloud Stream's source module interface and abstractions (e.g., `Supplier<>`, `MessageChannel`). Adapt configurations and property prefixes. Write new unit and integration tests.

activities.activity_name: Create Isolated Project for RedisRule Contract
activities.activity_description: Create a new, separate Maven project (e.g., `s-c-d-redis-test-support`). Extract the `@RedisRule` JUnit extension and its associated classes and dependencies from the core test suite into this new project. Publish it as a test-scoped artifact. Update the core project's test dependencies to use this new module.

activities.activity_name: Implement Foundation for OOTB Processor Modules
activities.activity_description: Define the base interfaces and abstract classes for a Processor module in Spring Cloud Stream context. Create a new Maven module within the `s-c-s-modules` repository. Implement at least one reference processor module (e.g., a simple filter or transformation) to validate the foundation. Write integration tests and update module catalog documentation.

Modify the `AetherModuleResolver` class to accept a configuration property (e.g., `spring.cloud.deployer.local.offline`). When enabled, configure the underlying Aether/Maven Resolver system to use only the local Maven repository (~/.m2/repository) and skip remote repository access. Write tests for both online and offline modes.

Design the `ModuleRegistry` interface with methods for registration, unregistration, and lookup of module coordinates by name. Implement an in-memory registry backed by a concurrent map. Implement persistence (optional, for demonstration: file-based). Write comprehensive unit tests for the implementation.

Extend the Spring Cloud Data Flow Shell command set. Implement four new commands: `module-info`, `module-list`, `module-register`, `module-unregister`. Wire these commands to the `ModuleRegistry` interface (U7). Write integration tests using the shell's test framework. Update the shell's help documentation.
